record.question: Who is the Men's Shot Put Gold Medal winner from India in the recently concluded Asian Athletics Championship at Doha?
record.explanation: Answer C: Tejinder Pal Singh Toor. Tejinder Pal Singh Toor won men’s shot put gold at the 2019 Asian Athletics Championships in Doha. Reference: https://www.worldathletics.org/competitions/continental-tour/news/asian-athletics-championships-doha-2019. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present.
